Title: handling adding and dropping players with the archon

Messages.Author: Chris.QJ
Messages.Body:
hi,

you run a tournament using the archon and after a round a player drops
or a new player shows up. what do you do?

when i still ran tuorneys i solved that using the following procedure
for adds:

go to the sheet for the previous round(s)
highlight the player number column
copy and paste _values_. thus the previous rounds are not affected by
the new player
add the player to the methuselahs sheet.
correct same predetor prey and starting player issues manually.
continue with the next round as if nothing had happened.

drops:
i never had that issue, but i guess i would have continued the tourney
and awarded a game loss to the player in each of the remainig rounds,
thus turning a 5 player table into a 4 player table. not the optimal
solution, but the only one i can think of at the moment
you could hanlde it the same as above, removing the player from the
meth sheet, but that would result in that player not showing up in the
final result sheet, so that is not an option.

it would be great to hear how other organizers handle this when using
the standard archon.

LSJ: is there a "_the_ way" to do this?

regards,
Chris.QJ

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris.QJ wrote:



Yes. Mark the Methuselah as withdrawn in the DQ Flag column ("wd" tends
to suffice to indicate the reason). Then go to the remaining rounds
and re-seat them as necessary as you had for the add (that is, check
to make sure that available VPs are equitably distributed and then
that pred-prey-other relationships are not repeated).
